review_type: A3 scoped static recovery regression review

scope.plan_items: lines 43-66 (24 rows) plus line 68 WED-A3-02 and WED-A3-03
scope.method: Read actual candidate source and trace branches; parse raw frontmatter using independent PyYAML SafeLoader and YAML node keys; parse JSON demo manifest and check file existence. No package imports or execution.
not_claimed: No overall A3 decision; final A2 evidence belongs to main review.
No runtime, payment, upstream, host UI, human likeness or platform upload verification.
Main owns ZIP integrity, image derivation and visual quality, HNF-A3-01 through HNF-A3-04 and final product decision.
Historical closure versions are evidence in the plan, not newly executed tests in this review.
Paths and bounded-decoder conclusions below are static source reasoning, not execution of package helpers.

checks.old_defect: paid in a new environment lacked an original-account entry and could imply payment registration without server evidence.
checks.observed_control_flow: ensure_install_secret preserves an existing installation identity. paid without identity or after balance 401 uses quick-entry and returns a linkAccount or creditsPending result; only a real balance response containing a non-bool integer greater than zero emits creditsConfirmed and actual remaining count. No user payment statement is treated as a receipt.

checks.old_defect: Expired or unvalidated server short links were relayed.
checks.observed_control_flow: link_fresh accepts only an explicit positive int expires_in. quick-entry and membership-link use the same original install identity and retry at most once for stale links; still-stale responses return EXPIRED. trusted_link checks first-party origin and allowed paths, then preserves ticket query/fragment. Existing baseline domain mapping is retained; this compression review does not claim a domain migration.

checks.old_defect: The final preference sentence in description omitted account intent.
checks.observed_control_flow: The original frontmatter description ends with explicit 汉服写真问题或本技能账户问题先调用. Host account takeover and new-chat account commands are separate from first-turn value demonstration.

checks.old_defect: Offline demo accessed credentials or sent telemetry/network requests.
checks.observed_control_flow: cmd_demo reads the local assets manifest, validates the requested file set, copies local files and emits md_safe_path values. Its full body contains no call, load_account or report_once; first-dialogue reporting belongs to cmd_first_turn.

checks.old_defect: Bilingual example counts matched while themes or pixel promises differed.
checks.observed_control_flow: Raw frontmatter was independently parsed by PyYAML SafeLoader. Three ordered pairs cover Tang chest-high/chest-tied ruqun, Song beizi with matching skirt, and Ming mamian skirt. Both languages state adult, own single-person photo, preserve appearance, portrait 2:3 and 1024×1536; not merely equal list lengths.

checks.old_defect: Spaces and Markdown-sensitive path characters broke file links.
checks.observed_control_flow: md_safe_path makes the path absolute, changes backslashes to forward slashes, escapes existing percent first and encodes space/tab/parentheses/angle brackets. Demo and delivered image/gallery link targets all use this helper. JSON manifest parsing found 10 entries and all 10 local files present. No CommonMark renderer or package path function was executed.

checks.old_defect: A literal # became a URI fragment and truncated image paths.
checks.observed_control_flow: The unsafe map explicitly encodes # as %23 and ? as %3F; an existing percent is first encoded to %25. Encoded image and gallery targets are passed through to the Markdown delivery builder rather than decoded back into target text.

checks.old_defect: Offline demo incorrectly triggered first-dialogue network reporting.
checks.observed_control_flow: cmd_demo remains local-only; the separate cmd_first_turn is the reporting entry point. The fact that historical wedding closure evidence is A2-level is preserved in the plan and is not represented as a newly run wedding check here.

checks.old_defect: Generation POST 401 followed by recovered by-key GET 404 could cause a second generation POST.
checks.observed_control_flow: _submit first saves submit_unknown and frozen body digest before its single POST. Its 401 branch goes to _submit_unauthorized, which may recover credentials once and GET only the original idem. GET 404, errors and malformed IDs return jobPending without a POST or key change. run/resume route unknown or existing tasks to original by-key/id queries; regenerate requires a finished state.

checks.old_defect: Recovery/query failure downgraded an unknown accepted task to confirmed, allowing replan to clear its original key/body.
checks.observed_control_flow: LOCKED_STATES includes submit_unknown/submitted/download_pending. plan checks the existing lock before _void_unsubmitted. Failed credential recovery emits credentialsReset(task_kept=true) without rewriting the draft; lookup failures retain the task state and original idem/body. resume continues original job; regeneration is refused unless actually terminal.

checks.old_defect: A missing demo was skipped and 9 of 10 was returned as success.
checks.observed_control_flow: _demo_manifest requires exactly all SCENES once, required string fields and safe bare PNG filenames. cmd_demo preflights every requested file before copying; any missing or copy failure returns demoUnavailable instead of partial success. Candidate manifest contains 10 expected unique keys and no missing file.

checks.old_defect: A saved Key was treated as ready despite false/missing/failed binding acknowledgement.
checks.observed_control_flow: New keys are saved privately with skill_key_bound=False. _confirm_bound accepts only dict bound is True before setting the marker and returning ok. cmd_run reaches _submit only when _ensure_skill_key returns ok; exceptions, missing/false binding and malformed key results exit without new generation.

checks.old_defect: Binding 401 retained a stale cached Key and caused permanent recovery loops.
checks.observed_control_flow: A binding 401 removes both cached skill_key and skill_key_bound and saves the account, preserving install_secret and draft. key_reset returns exit 4 with task_kept=true. Recovery obtains a new key using the original identity and requires binding confirmation again; original tasks still follow GET-only continuation.

checks.old_defect: Header-only PNG/JPEG checks accepted truncated or damaged images.
checks.observed_control_flow: Input audit limits bytes/dimensions, checks every PNG chunk boundary/CRC, required structure, zlib EOF and row lengths/filters. JPEG parses marker lengths/tables, fully decodes required entropy MCU units, checks truncated bit consumption/restart sequence and requires EOI plus component scans. Delivery verifies complete PNG before writing success; invalid downloads remain download_pending and are fetched by the original job.

checks.old_defect: PNG zlib output and repeated JPEG DHT lookup construction lacked resource budgets.
checks.observed_control_flow: Both input PNG audit and delivery verify use shared inflate_rows: each decompress has limit=max(1,min(65536,remaining+1)), output is consumed immediately, unconsumed_tail is drained with the same cap, unused_data rejects, EOF/remaining are checked without flush. JPEG DHT stores checked definition bytes without building a table; only scan-referenced definitions build cached lookups, equal definitions reuse one table, builds stop at 32 and scans at 64. Input JPEG size is rejected before entropy work.

checks.old_defect: First-dialogue telemetry failure automatically retried on later commands.
checks.observed_control_flow: report_once honors OFF and sent/attempted. attempted=True is atomically saved and read back before transport; every later report_once exits already even after transport/status/receipt failure. Exactly eight fields, no redirect handler, 2-second timeout and 4096-byte read remain. Server event_id is stored as canonical for receipt/account linking, not assumed equal to the request event_id.

checks.old_defect: Generic environment words overrode specific clothing intent.
checks.observed_control_flow: Hanfu adaptation retains specific form > style > dynasty > generic environment ordering, with negated words stripped first. Boundary/main-need hints are separate from scene choice, and the host must use scenes.md context rather than reject negated words. Travel scenes are not inherited into the Hanfu product.

checks.old_defect: Photo transfer consent did not identify image-service/compute recipient categories.
checks.observed_control_flow: Confirmation copy explicitly names 图片服务及算力供应商 and limits transfer to this photo/current production. Owner/upload/pay are separate gates in host instructions and cmd_confirm. The generated body sets reference_consent only after these gates, source-digest validation and local image audit.

checks.old_defect: An unquoted colon-space in English description broke original YAML.
checks.observed_control_flow: Original SKILL frontmatter was directly parsed by independent PyYAML SafeLoader; YAML node keys contain no duplicates, version is 1.0.2, examples are arrays of strings. The description fields are quoted scalars; no projection or split-on-colon validator was substituted.

checks.old_defect: A deleted/corrupt confirmed photo reached account/Key HTTP before local validation.
checks.observed_control_flow: For unsubmitted run, _job_body fully audits input and validates raw source SHA before load_account/_account_ready/_ensure_skill_key. needs_credits without a job performs the same local check before its balance GET. Existing jobs and submit_unknown branch to original task lookup before consulting mutable local photo content. Only separate one-shot telemetry may precede local input rejection.

checks.old_defect: Adult was not asked, unknown was treated as no, and changing the photo was advised to bypass eligibility.
checks.observed_control_flow: Host fills unknown for unasked self/adult and merges factual questions. plan explicitly distinguishes no from unknown: no gives the actual minor/not-self reason; unknown returns needsEligibility. Copy asks self/adult from user statement, no age inference or proof; no maternity-stage rule is inherited.

checks.old_defect: Unsubmitted A replan to unknown/no/bad B returned before durable invalidation, letting resume submit old A.
checks.observed_control_flow: After protecting already-submitted locks, plan invokes _void_unsubmitted before scene/form/eligibility/text/new-photo validation. It clears three consents, idem/job/body digest and saves replanning; new image path is saved and old photo SHA cleared before any early return. confirm requires planned, while run/resume/regenerate explicitly stop replanning. Only successful plan plus new confirmation can create a new key.

checks.old_defect: A Windows backslash-dot state directory or unnormalized separators broke Markdown paths.
checks.observed_control_flow: state_dir uses a non-dot SKILL_ID directory. md_safe_path normalizes absolute Windows paths to forward slashes before encoding unsafe characters; all user demo/result/gallery targets use it. This is the named slash regression, not an invented independent A3 defect ID.

checks.old_defect: Named regression requires preserving the exact fixed welcome sentence; withdrawn certification objections are not revived.
checks.observed_control_flow: WELCOME is the literal 欢迎使用WorkBuddy官方认证技能 + one ASCII space + SKILL_NAME(汉服写真照相馆) + Chinese full stop, yielding 欢迎使用WorkBuddy官方认证技能 汉服写真照相馆。. first-turn emits the same W.WELCOME and host requires verbatim copying.

checks.old_defect: Replacing a photo at the same path after planning left old consent and task key usable.
checks.observed_control_flow: Successful plan freezes source SHA. confirm rehashes before minting the key; _job_body audits and compares the exact raw bytes again before account HTTP; mismatch _photo_changed durably clears all consents/key. _submit also rejects a changed frozen body digest. Already-submitted unknown tasks keep their original query lock instead of reading a changed photo and resubmitting.

checks.old_defect: Delivered image/gallery Markdown targets omitted safe-path encoding.
checks.observed_control_flow: _deliver creates separate non-overwriting output files, converts each user image target and index.html target through md_safe_path and passes those encoded targets to W.delivery. W.delivery escapes label metacharacters and uses the supplied target unchanged. HTML gallery image filenames separately use URL quote.

supplemental_confirmation.observed: SKILL53 excludes feedback from automatic retry; SKILL119 requires explicit feedback --retry when no ticket ID. Unknown submission retains stored body/key and output auto_retry=false; original task recovery does not invoke support submission.

conclusion: The 26 named historical regression constraints show no static regression in the actual clean 1.0.2 candidate. This is a scoped source review only and does not substitute for main's final A2/overall A3 decision.
